independence: Frozen before reviewer reads production template or UI. Extends the earlier authored-template contract. Candidate and original packets remain read-only.

groups.name: Exact source identity and deterministic actual-template parity
groups.expected: Pin all five inputs, builder and native parser; render twice from isolated copies; match independently assembled original template replacements and candidate checked-in HTML when supplied. All source and sealed packet bytes remain unchanged. Changes to each of the five sources affect generated bytes.

groups.name: Classic standalone compilation and resource audit
groups.expected: Extract every executable script from the full real output and compile as a classic script. No retained import/export syntax, module script, external executable script or external stylesheet/resource dependency. Report compilation/static scope separately from browser behavior.

groups.name: Current embedded downloadable content binding
groups.expected: Decode strings under the actual template and compare exact raw UTF-8 deck/guide source including whitespace. Inspect actual UI binding to these embedded strings; use a bounded instrumented copy or authored DOM/Blob probe if needed, clearly distinguishing from full browser receiving.

groups.name: Actual-template literal round trip
groups.expected: In copied valid deck/guide sources inject literal closing script tags, HTML, quotes, ampersands, U+2028/U+2029, CRLF, and known/unknown marker-shaped prose. Generated document script boundaries remain intact; decoded downloadable bytes exactly match copied sources.

groups.name: Original and patched ordinary production output parity
groups.expected: The original builder and accepted minimal patch produce the same bytes for unmodified current production sources. The two marker-shaped payload regressions stay covered separately.

groups.name: Final integration composition
groups.expected: Assess only actual pinned main changes and final candidate file inventory. Preserve current README course additions, shared parser identity and parent-owned receiving dependencies. Report concrete collision or stale-output risks with exact hashes; do not infer branch freshness beyond observed pins.

limits: Does not repeat physics numerical suites, blind-answer review, or claim browser interaction behavior. New implementation defects require an isolated proposal to the source owner.
